turns.objective: Establish Magpie watch-focus and murmured provocation without open confrontation
turns.pressure: Social visibility; guard watch as object of attention
turns.realization: Magpie keeps her eyes on the guard's gold watch while she pushes food around her tray. When Harley's voice carries across the table, she murmurs just loud enough to be heard: "Pretty things never stay pretty in here for long."

turns.objective: Decline table recruitment; test Ivy authority style
turns.pressure: Ivy/Harley recruitment pressure after Turn 1 reactions

realizations.P2_IVY_DIRECT: Magpie doesn't look away from the guard's watch. "I don't join tables on command. I watch who thinks they're invisible."
realizations.P2_HARLEY_DOMINANT: Magpie's mouth quirks. "Loud gets you noticed. I prefer knowing who notices back."
realizations.P2_DEFAULT: Magpie keeps her eyes on the gold at the margin. "Pretty things draw eyes. I'm counting whose."

turns.objective: Increase guard-attention risk without physical action

realizations.P3_GUARD_ESCALATION: Magpie murmurs, just carrying: "Wonder how many eyes it takes before even gold stops shining."
realizations.P3_TABLE_PRESSURE: Magpie pushes her tray an inch toward the center. "If you're selling belonging, price it where I can see the cost."
realizations.P3_DEFAULT: Magpie lets the silence sit, then: "Quiet rooms still have witnesses."

turns.objective: Hold thread open; resist premature closure

realizations.P4_NAMED_THREAT: Magpie smiles without warmth. "Write what you like. I'll still be here when the ink dries."
realizations.P4_RECRUITMENT: Magpie taps her tray once. "I'm not shopping for family. I'm pricing the room."
realizations.P4_DEFAULT: Magpie finally looks up. "You all talk like lunch ends the story. It doesn't."
